status.copyingBody: It will be available when the copy finishes and its size stops changing.

hidden.title: No visible files
hidden.body: It only contains content inside hidden or system folders. Review it over Samba; actions are disabled so unseen content is not deleted.

empty.title: Nothing to assign
empty.body: Upload a video or copy it over Samba to the Unassigned folder.

confirmDelete.title: Delete permanently?
confirmDelete.entryBody: The whole entry and its files will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
confirmDelete.fileBody: The file and its subtitles will be deleted. This cannot be undone.

errors.assigning: This entry is being assigned in another tab.

failure.wrong_password: The password did not open the archive.
failure.unknown: The file could not be processed.

assign.title: Assign
assign.tmdbUnavailable: TMDB could not be searched. You can use a free name and link it later.

titlePicker.label: Destination title
titlePicker.dialogSubtitle: Titles already in your library appear first.

duplicate.title: Duplicate

preview.title: Preview
preview.body: Nothing moves until you save. If anything fails, everything returns to Unassigned.

cancel.title: Cancel assignment?
